authoredFrom: Erlang reference manual on -export/-export_type/-import, plus the store's own family precedent for each shape. Three ontology-audit findings, all found by comparing this analyzer against 25 SymbolKind values and 10 relationship values rather than by reading it: (1) ER-D39 — 8 analyzers emit kind=macro (C at real-c-analyzer.ts:3989 splits on isFunctionLikeMacro ? Macro : Constant, and lsp/identity.ts:77 already names `macro` as distinct from `constant`), yet every Erlang -define was published as `constant`, so a parameterized macro claimed to be a value; (2) ER-D40 — 16 analyzers emit an `exports` relationship and `-export([f/1])` is a public-surface declaration, but it reached the store only as ExportInfo while `contains` (membership) stood in for it, so the one label that says 'this is the interface' was stored and compared against nothing; (3) ER-D41 — 19 analyzers emit `imports` (brain_import rows, which dependencies.ts:27-28 reads precisely because resolved_symbol_id is often null), yet -import emitted only `references`, so the dependency pass could not see an Erlang import at all. Each edge is named at its own name-bearing node: the `fa` inside the export list, the module atom inside -import, per M60 #278.
